title: SREV-034 cred aw conversion

audit_contract.description: API: Cred_CREDENTIALA2W / Cred_CREDENTIALW2A | data: {"input": ["CREDENTIALA", "CREDENTIALW", "CREDENTIAL_TARGET_INFORMATIONA"], "output": ["single LocalAlloc block containing the converted structure", "all converted string pointers point inside the output block", "attribute array storage precedes converted attribute keywords"]}

validation_invariants.description: All contracts listed in the contracts metadata must hold before any data is trusted past the validation boundary

runtime_matrix.description: Windows runtime gate proves contracts hold under normal and malformed inputs

contracts: conversion output cursor starts inside the newly allocated output block
Cred_CREDENTIALW2A must not write converted strings into the input CREDENTIALW block
Cred_CopyW2A writes bytes through char*, not WCHAR*
attribute array cursor advances by sizeof(CREDENTIAL_ATTRIBUTEA/W), not sizeof(pointer)
LocalAlloc failure returns NULL and caller fails with ERROR_NOT_ENOUGH_MEMORY
CredentialBlob and attribute Value pointers keep their source ownership because this local shim only converts structure/string shape
